description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that contains a comprehensive set of tests for the 'git difftool' command and its various options and configurations. It includes setup steps, test cases for behavior under different flags, environment variables, config settings, and interactions with the working directory, submodules, symlinks, and other scenarios, primarily aimed at verifying the functionality and robustness of the git difftool feature.

methods.name: difftool_test_setup
methods.description: Sets up test configuration for diff tool assertions, including configuring custom diff commands.

methods.name: prompt_given
methods.description: Evaluates whether the prompt given matches the expected 'Launch' message.

methods.name: run_dir_diff_test
methods.description: Runs a directory diff test with specified options, checking symlink handling if applicable.
